scripts.config:check: bun -e "const jsonFiles = ['package.json', 'biome.json', 'tsconfig.json', 'tsconfig.node.json', 'capacitor.config.json']; const yamlFiles = ['render.yaml', '.github/workflows/ci.yml', '.github/workflows/release.yml']; const workflowFiles = ['.github/workflows/ci.yml', '.github/workflows/release.yml']; for (const file of jsonFiles) JSON.parse(await Bun.file(file).text()); for (const file of yamlFiles) Bun.YAML.parse(await Bun.file(file).text()); for (const file of workflowFiles) { const workflow = Bun.YAML.parse(await Bun.file(file).text()); if (!workflow || typeof workflow !== 'object' || typeof workflow.jobs !== 'object') throw new Error('Invalid workflow structure: ' + file); for (const job of Object.values(workflow.jobs)) { if (!job || typeof job !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(job.steps)) throw new Error('Workflow job has no steps: ' + file); for (const step of job.steps) { if (step.uses && !/^[^@]+@[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(step.uses)) throw new Error('Unpinned workflow action: ' + step.uses); } } } console.log('Configuration syntax is valid.');"
scripts.assets:check: bun -e "const { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } = await import('node:fs'); const { join } = await import('node:path'); const problems = []; const warnings = []; const pngSize = (file) => { const bytes = readFileSync(file); if (bytes.length < 24 || bytes.readUInt32BE(0) !== 0x89504e47) return null; return { width: bytes.readUInt32BE(16), height: bytes.readUInt32BE(20) }; }; const assetRef = /['\"](\/(?:assets\/)?[A-Za-z0-9._\/-]+\.(?:png|ico|svg|webp|jpg|jpeg|mp3|m4a|aac|wav|woff2?))['\"]/g; const collect = (text) => { const found = new Set(); for (const match of text.matchAll(assetRef)) found.add(match[1]); return found; }; const referenced = new Map(); const texts = []; for (const file of ['index.html', 'vite.config.ts']) { const text = await Bun.file(file).text(); texts.push(text); for (const ref of collect(text)) { const list = referenced.get(ref) ?? []; list.push(file); referenced.set(ref, list); } } for (const file of ['src']) { const stack = [file]; while (stack.length > 0) { const current = stack.pop(); for (const entry of readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true })) { const next = join(current, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) stack.push(next); else if (/\.(?:ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|html)$/.test(entry.name)) { const text = await Bun.file(next).text(); texts.push(text); for (const ref of collect(text)) { const list = referenced.get(ref) ?? []; list.push(next); referenced.set(ref, list); } } } } } for (const [ref, sources] of referenced) { const normalized = ref.replace(/^\//, ''); const onDisk = join('public', normalized); if (!existsSync(onDisk)) { problems.push('Missing public asset ' + normalized + ' (referenced by ' + sources.join(', ') + ')'); continue; } if (statSync(onDisk).size === 0) { problems.push('Empty public asset ' + normalized); continue; } const declared = /^([0-9]+)x([0-9]+)/.exec(normalized); if (declared && normalized.endsWith('.png')) { const size = pngSize(onDisk); if (!size) problems.push(normalized + ' is not a readable PNG'); else if (size.width !== Number(declared[1]) || size.height !== Number(declared[2])) problems.push(normalized + ' is ' + size.width + 'x' + size.height + ' but its filename declares ' + declared[1] + 'x' + declared[2]); } } const walk = (directory) => { const out = []; for (const entry of readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) { const next = join(directory, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) out.push(...walk(next)); else out.push(next); } return out; }; for (const file of walk('public')) { const normalized = file.split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/').replace(/^public\//, ''); if (!referenced.has('/' + normalized) && !texts.some((text) => text.includes(normalized))) warnings.push('Unreferenced public asset: ' + normalized); } for (const warning of warnings) console.warn('warning: ' + warning); if (problems.length > 0) throw new Error('Public asset validation failed:\n - ' + problems.join('\n - ')); console.log('Public assets are valid (' + referenced.size + ' referenced, ' + warnings.length + ' unreferenced).');"
scripts.pwa:check: bun -e "const { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } = await import('node:fs'); const { join } = await import('node:path'); const problems = []; let precacheBytes = 0; let precachedSet = new Set(); const pngSize = (file) => { const bytes = readFileSync(file); if (bytes.length < 24 || bytes.readUInt32BE(0) !== 0x89504e47) return null; return { width: bytes.readUInt32BE(16), height: bytes.readUInt32BE(20) }; }; for (const file of ['dist/index.html', 'dist/manifest.webmanifest', 'dist/registerSW.js', 'dist/sw.js']) if (!existsSync(file) || readFileSync(file).length === 0) problems.push('Missing or empty build output: ' + file); if (problems.length === 0) { const html = await Bun.file('dist/index.html').text(); if (!/<link[^>]*rel=\"manifest\"/.test(html)) problems.push('dist/index.html has no manifest link'); if (!/<script[^>]*src=\"\/registerSW\.js\"/.test(html)) problems.push('dist/index.html does not load /registerSW.js'); if (/<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)[^>]*>\s*[^<>\s][^<>]*<\/script>/.test(html)) problems.push('dist/index.html contains an inline script that the deployed script-src policy blocks'); const manifest = await Bun.file('dist/manifest.webmanifest').json(); const icons = Array.isArray(manifest.icons) ? manifest.icons : []; if (icons.length === 0) problems.push('dist/manifest.webmanifest declares no icons'); if (manifest.start_url !== '/' || manifest.scope !== '/') problems.push('Manifest start_url/scope must be /'); for (const icon of icons) { const file = join('dist', icon.src.replace(/^\//, '')); if (!existsSync(file)) { problems.push('Manifest icon missing from dist: ' + icon.src); continue; } const declared = /^([0-9]+)x([0-9]+)$/.exec(icon.sizes ?? ''); if (declared && icon.src.endsWith('.png')) { const size = pngSize(file); if (!size) problems.push(icon.src + ' is not a readable PNG'); else if (size.width !== Number(declared[1]) || size.height !== Number(declared[2])) problems.push(icon.src + ' is ' + size.width + 'x' + size.height + ' but the manifest declares ' + icon.sizes); } } const serviceWorker = readFileSync('dist/sw.js', 'utf8'); const precached = [...serviceWorker.matchAll(/url:\"([^\"]+)\"/g)].map((match) => match[1]); if (precached.length === 0) problems.push('dist/sw.js has an empty precache manifest'); for (const url of new Set(precached)) if (!existsSync(join('dist', url))) problems.push('Precached URL missing from dist: ' + url); precachedSet = new Set(precached); const walkDist = (directory) => { const out = []; for (const entry of readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) { const next = join(directory, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) out.push(...walkDist(next)); else out.push(next); } return out; }; for (const file of walkDist('dist')) { const relative = file.replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(92), '/').slice('dist/'.length); const size = statSync(file).size; const buildRuntimeFile = relative === 'sw.js' || /^workbox-[^/]*\.js$/.test(relative) || relative.endsWith('.map'); if (precachedSet.has(relative)) { precacheBytes += size; continue; } if (buildRuntimeFile) continue; problems.push('Built file is not precached and so is unavailable offline: ' + relative + ' (' + size + ' bytes). Raise workbox.maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes in vite.config.ts, extend workbox.globPatterns, or drop the file.'); } const duplicated = new Map(); for (const url of precached) duplicated.set(url, (duplicated.get(url) ?? 0) + 1); for (const [url, count] of duplicated) { const injectedByPlugin = url === 'manifest.webmanifest' || /^assets\/pwa-[^/]*\.png$/.test(url); if (count > 2 || (count > 1 && !injectedByPlugin)) problems.push('Duplicate precache entries: ' + url + ' appears ' + count + ' times'); } for (const icon of icons) if (!precached.includes(icon.src.startsWith('/') ? icon.src.slice(1) : icon.src)) problems.push('Manifest icon is not precached: ' + icon.src); for (const shortcut of Array.isArray(manifest.shortcuts) ? manifest.shortcuts : []) if (typeof shortcut.url !== 'string' || !shortcut.url.startsWith('/')) problems.push('Manifest shortcut url must be a root-relative path: ' + JSON.stringify(shortcut.url)); } if (problems.length > 0) throw new Error('PWA output validation failed:\n - ' + problems.join('\n - ')); console.log('PWA output is valid (' + precachedSet.size + ' precached URLs, ' + (precacheBytes / 1048576).toFixed(2) + ' MiB precached).');"
scripts.license:check: bun -e "const allowed = new Set(['0BSD', 'Apache-2.0', 'BlueOak-1.0.0', 'BSD-2-Clause', 'BSD-2-Clause-Patent', 'BSD-3-Clause', 'BSD-3-Clause-Clear', 'CC-BY-4.0', 'CC0-1.0', 'ISC', 'MIT', 'MIT-0', 'MPL-2.0', 'Python-2.0', 'Unicode-3.0', 'Unlicense', 'Zlib']); const { existsSync, readdirSync, realpathSync } = await import('node:fs'); const { join } = await import('node:path'); const rejected = []; const visited = new Set(); let inspected = 0; if (!existsSync('node_modules')) throw new Error('node_modules is missing; run bun install --frozen-lockfile before license:check'); const inspect = async (directory) => { const manifestPath = join(directory, 'package.json'); if (!existsSync(manifestPath)) return; const manifestKey = realpathSync(manifestPath); if (visited.has(manifestKey)) return; visited.add(manifestKey); inspected++; const pkg = await Bun.file(manifestPath).json(); const declared = pkg.license ?? pkg.licenses; const value = Array.isArray(declared) ? declared : [declared]; const licenses = value.filter(Boolean).map((license) => typeof license === 'string' ? license : license.type); const accepted = licenses.some((license) => [...allowed].some((allowedLicense) => license.includes(allowedLicense))); if (!accepted) rejected.push(pkg.name + '@' + pkg.version + ': ' + (licenses.join(' OR ') || 'unknown')); const nested = join(directory, 'node_modules'); if (existsSync(nested)) await scan(nested); }; const scan = async (modulesDirectory) => { for (const entry of readdirSync(modulesDirectory, { withFileTypes: true })) { if (entry.name.startsWith('.')) continue; const entryPath = join(modulesDirectory, entry.name); if (entry.name.startsWith('@')) { for (const scopedEntry of readdirSync(entryPath, { withFileTypes: true })) { if (!scopedEntry.name.startsWith('.')) await inspect(join(entryPath, scopedEntry.name)); } } else { await inspect(entryPath); } } }; await scan('node_modules'); if (inspected === 0) throw new Error('No installed packages were inspected; license:check would pass vacuously'); if (rejected.length > 0) throw new Error('Disallowed or unknown licenses:\n' + rejected.join('\n')); console.log('Dependency licenses accepted (' + inspected + ' packages inspected).');"
